plugins.name: release-engineering
plugins.description: The release-engineering role directive and phase-1/phase-2 norm composer on contract v3 (issue-33): itself owns no methodology gate; composes proposal-norm (phase 1) and readiness-checklist + rollout-plan + error-budget-policy + postmortem (phase 2, together) into one role directive.

plugins.name: proposal-norm
plugins.description: The release-engineering phase-1 norm, alone: every docs/issue-<n>/proposals/*.md is RFC-shaped (scope/change description, a named risk, a rollback/back-out path, sourced-evidence citation) before it may be written.

plugins.name: readiness-checklist
plugins.description: One of four release-engineering phase-2 norm plugins: the seven-dimension production readiness review, gated so a “yes” with no pointable artifact is a FAIL, not a pass with a caveat.

plugins.name: rollout-plan
plugins.description: One of four release-engineering phase-2 norm plugins: pre-declared per-step, per-metric rollout thresholds — a step may not resolve pass/fail with an unset threshold.

plugins.name: error-budget-policy
plugins.description: One of four release-engineering phase-2 norm plugins: the error-budget hard stop — steady -> readiness is refused outright while error_budget reads exhausted, non-discretionary.

plugins.name: postmortem
plugins.description: One of four release-engineering phase-2 norm plugins: incident -> steady requires a HUMAN-reviewed postmortem, never a self-certified draft.
